entities.name: Norika Yamazaki
entities.description: Human samurai general of the Imperials and eldest daughter of the Yamazaki clan.

entities.name: Naomi
entities.description: Imperial advisor Norika served as aide.

entities.name: Asari Uprisers
entities.description: Rebel movement Norika was tasked to stamp out.

entities.name: Heiko Yamazaki
entities.description: Norika's cousin and former best friend, a rebel.

entities.name: Eiganjo Castle
entities.description: Site of the merge gate accident.

events.summary: An accident at the Eiganjo merge gate left Norika in permanent pain at age ten.
events.quote: an accident at the Eiganjo Castle merge gate with an Unforgiving One caused her to be permanently in pain.

events.summary: At 32 Norika was tasked with stamping out the Asari Uprisers, facing her cousin Heiko.
events.quote: she was given the task of stamping out the Asari Uprisers

relations.quote: she faced off against her cousin and former childhood best friend: Heiko Yamazaki .
